QUOTE: Default build (`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` off, `mbedtls_config.h:3787`) ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` is also off by default (`mbedtls_config.h:2185`)
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the wrong macro pair (THREADING_C and THREADING_ALT, not the item's two threading macros, presumably THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD). It also admits the "off by default" claim was not read from the shipped config, so it never states that the shipped file leaves both macros undefined.
